concepts.name: water cycle
concepts.definition: The process describing how water moves between the atmosphere, the land, and bodies of water.

concepts.name: atmosphere
concepts.definition: One of the locations where water moves in the cycle.

concepts.name: land
concepts.definition: One of the locations where water moves in the cycle.

concepts.name: bodies of water
concepts.definition: Locations where water moves in the cycle.

concepts.name: oceans
concepts.definition: A body of water that stores water in reservoirs.

concepts.name: water
concepts.definition: The substance stored in reservoirs like oceans, lakes, and soil.

concepts.name: lakes
concepts.definition: A body of water that stores water in reservoirs.

concepts.name: rivers
concepts.definition: A body of water that stores water in reservoirs.

concepts.name: soil
concepts.definition: A medium that stores water in reservoirs.

concepts.name: groundwater
concepts.definition: Water stored underground in reservoirs.

concepts.name: snow
concepts.definition: Frozen water stored in reservoirs.

concepts.name: ice
concepts.definition: Frozen water stored in reservoirs.

concepts.name: evaporation
concepts.definition: The process of changing liquid water into water vapor.

concepts.name: liquid water to water vapor change
concepts.definition: The transformation of liquid water into water vapor.
aliases: liquid water to water vapor change

concepts.name: condensation
concepts.definition: The process of changing vapor back into liquid.

concepts.name: vapor to liquid change
concepts.definition: The transformation of vapor back into liquid.

concepts.name: solar energy
concepts.definition: Energy supplied for evaporation from oceans, lakes, and moist ground.

concepts.name: humidity
concepts.definition: A factor affecting the rate of evaporation.

concepts.name: wind
concepts.definition: A factor affecting the rate of evaporation.

concepts.name: availability of water
concepts.definition: A factor affecting the rate of evaporation.

concepts.name: plants
concepts.definition: Organisms that absorb water through roots and release vapor through stomata.

concepts.name: water (9b2cc063)
concepts.definition: The substance absorbed by plants through roots.
